profile.name: Daniel de Gois
profile.tagline: I build web applications, games and software that people can open, use and come back to.
about: I'm Daniel, a software developer who builds web applications, games and practical tools. I like taking an idea from a rough sketch to something people can open on their phone and use every day.
I care about clean interfaces, fast pages and the small details that make an app feel finished. Most of what I build runs in the browser and works just as well on mobile.
This site is my home base. Every project I ship has a link here, so the Projects tab is the best place to see what I've been working on.
profile.drumsIntro: Away from the keyboard I like to keep healthy and stay active. I play golf and basketball, and I play drums.
profile.codeIntro: I build for the browser first and keep picking up new tools as projects need them.

projects.title: Chalkline
projects.desc: A lesson planner for teachers, with lesson ideas, calendar planning, classroom themes and morning routines. Works on phones and can be added to the home screen like an app.
